name: receivables
notes: Beyond the spec's route list the module adds GET /receivables/receipts and /receivables/receipts/:id, GET /receivables/customers/:id/open-invoices|balance|suggest-allocation, GET /receivables/pdcs/:id, POST /receivables/pdcs (not provided: cheques are created with their receipt), POST /receivables/adjustments/approval-requests (BR-11: asks the owner to approve a write-off and returns the approval doc id that POST /receivables/adjustments takes) and GET /receivables/adjustments. A cleared cheque can still bounce (AC-2: the cash movement is then reversed through the cash book); a bounce or cancellation is refused when billing has already recorded an advance of that receipt as received, because billing cannot take it back. Aging and balances read the issued-invoice view bil_v_invoices: credit notes count in full from the day they exist (the view has no issue date). The reconciled check and the reversal use the cash book's transactions service.
